name: Meaning Of Jubilee
overview: The biblical concept of Jubilee, as revealed in Leviticus 25, centers on a divinely ordained cycle of rest and restoration occurring every fiftieth year, following seven cycles of seven years. During this Jubilee year, liberty is proclaimed throughout the land, and individuals return to their original possessions and families, symbolizing God’s provision and faithfulness. This principle of rest is foreshadowed in the seventh year Sabbath of the land described in Exodus 23, where fields lie fallow to provide for the poor and the creatures of the land. Together, these passages illustrate a God-centered system of mercy and renewal designed to maintain social and spiritual order among His people.
